system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: cloudrun-service
    type: cloudrun.v1.service
    properties:
      service:
        metadata:
          name: python-api-service
        spec:
          template:
            spec:
              containers:
              - image: gcr.io/[PROJECT_ID]/python-api-image
                ports:
                - containerPort: 8080
          traffic:
          - percent: 100
            latestRevision: true
      location: us-central1

  - name: python-api-image
    action: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
    properties:
      docker:
        dockerfile: |
          # Use an official lightweight Python image.
          # https://hub.docker.com/_/python
          FROM python:3.12-slim

          # Set environment variables
          ENV APP_HOME /app
          WORKDIR $APP_HOME

          # Install any needed packages specified in requirements.txt
          COPY requirements.txt .
          RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

          # Copy application code
          COPY . .

          # Make port 8080 available to the world outside this container
          EXPOSE 8080

          # Define environment variable
          ENV NAME World

          # Run app.py when the container launches
          CMD ["python", "app.py"]
        images:
        - gcr.io/[PROJECT_ID]/python-api-image

  - name: cloudrun-service-iam-policy
    type: cloudrun.v1.serviceIamPolicy
    properties:
      service: python-api-service
      location: us-central1
      policy:
        bindings:
        - role: roles/run.invoker
          members:
          - allUsers

  - name: cloudrun-service-logging
    type: logging.v2.sink
    properties:
      parent: projects/[PROJECT_ID]
      sink: cloudrun-service-logs
      destination: logging.googleapis.com/projects/[PROJECT_ID]/logs/cloudrun-service-log
      filter: 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="python-api-service"'
      uniqueWriterIdentity: true

  - name: cloudrun-service-monitoring
    type: monitoring.v3.alertPolicy
    properties:
      displayName: Cloud Run Service Alert Policy
      combiner: OR
      conditions:
      - conditionThreshold:
          thresholdValue: 0.5
          comparisonOperator: COMPARISON_GT
          duration: 300s
          query: 'select count(*) from log_entry WHERE resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="python-api-service" AND severity >= WARNING'
        displayName: Cloud Run Service Error Rate
      documentation:
        content: 'Alerts when Cloud Run service error rate exceeds threshold'
        mime_type: text/markdown
      enabled: true
